description: Sends a PDF proof of the company. It does not start OCR. Requires a session; for large files, prefer HTTP. Returns 201. JSON up to 11,200,000 bytes; PDF up to 8 MiB; 20 documents, 80 MiB and 50 pages per company. An identical file is reused. The automatic reading happens only when you request the analysis.

arquivo_base64.description: The PDF in base64, up to 8 MiB decoded.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with 14 characters (digits or alphanumeric) linked to the owner.
